measurement_note: Size is n, the string length. Each tier contains n-1 copies of a followed by b, so the complete string must be counted and the result is floor(100(n-1)/n). One count takes O(n) time. Correctly recounting every growing prefix completes all legal tiers and fails through O(n^2) scaling.
